The name Kumar signifies that the child is a precious gift from the gods and is destined to bring pride and joy to his family.

The name Ritesh signifies the divine power of righteousness and the wish for the child to uphold dharma in his life. The name Kumar signifies the concept of Tējas, or divine fire, which is believed to reside in every individual. It is the responsibility of every individual to nurture this divine fire within and use it to lead a righteous and virtuous life. The name Riteshkumar is a reminder of this sacred duty and is a powerful inspiration for the child to live a life that is in harmony with dharma and leads to spiritual growth.
